entities.name: Mohamed Taieb Naciri
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Mohamed Taieb Naciri was a Moroccan lawyer and politician who held the position of Minister of Justice between 2010 and 2012 in the cabinet of Abbas El Fassi. Naciri worked as the attorney of the Moroccan royal family during much of his career.
